page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 32 GB of system memory. The instance includes a single NVIDIA Pascal-based P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates modest CPU and memory performance. The single-core stress-ng performance falls into the bottom 10%, while multi-core stress-ng and Passmark CPU extended instructions rank in the bottom 25%. The Passmark CPU score sits in the average range. Memory bandwidth and database operations also register in the bottom 25%, reflecting the older Broadwell architecture and Pascal-era memory bus.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge offers a budget-friendly entry point for GPU-accelerated tasks that do not require modern tensor cores or high-throughput memory. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and an NVIDIA P4 GPU makes this instance suitable for entry-level deep learning inference, video transcoding, lightweight graphics rendering, and legacy CUDA-based applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for entry-level parallel processing workloads. It is equipped with 8 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz, 32 GB of system memory, and a single NVIDIA Tesla P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance does not feature local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Benchmark results indicate modest performance, with single-core stress-ng scores in the bottom 10% and multi-core performance in the bottom 25%, though its Passmark CPU score reaches the middle 50%. Given its older Pascal GPU architecture and Broadwell CPU, this instance represents a cost-effective option for workloads that require GPU acceleration without the premium price of newer hardware generations. It is best suited for lightweight deep learning inference, video encoding, and legacy CUDA applications.
